column2: I have been informed that things have gone even better than expected. Not only the people of [Root.Capital.GetName] are preparing for rebellion, but also the people in nearby areas.
That went beyond my wildest dreams!

[Root.GetBestName],
I am writing you to inform you that things have turned out even better than expected. Soon, more than just the good people of [From.Capital.GetName] will rise up in my name and the name of the [From.Capital.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!

Signed and sealed by my hand,
[From.GetTitledName]
Great to hear!
I have been informed that things went fairly well. The people of [Root.Capital.GetName] are preparing for rebellion.
That went well!

[Root.GetBestName],
I am writing you to inform you that things have turned out very well. The good people of [From.Capital.GetName] will soon rise up in my name and the name of the [From.Capital.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!

Signed and sealed by my hand,
[From.GetTitledName]
Good news!
My efforts to convince the good people of [Root.Capital.GetName] to rise up in rebellion in my name have failed. Luckily, [Root.TopLiege.GetTitledName] is none the wiser.
I suppose that could have gone better...

[Root.GetBestName],
I am writing you to inform you that things have not gone as expected. While our efforts to make the good people of [From.Capital.GetName] rise up in rebellion were not discovered, the attempt has been met with failure.

Signed and sealed by my hand,
[From.GetTitledName]
These things happen...

I have been informed that not only the people of [Root.Capital.GetName] are preparing for rebellion, but also the people in nearby areas. Unfortunately, I have also learned that [Root.TopLiege.GetBestName] has learned of the unrest and my involvement in it.
That both went better and worse than I had hoped...

[Root.GetBestName],
I am writing you to inform you that while there now is a great deal of rebellious sentiment in [From.Capital.GetName] and nearby areas it seems [From.TopLiege.GetBestName] has learned that I am behind it.

Signed and sealed by my hand,
[From.GetTitledName]
I hope my involvement remains unknown...
